geslotenIssues.result: Successful header/footer opening is remembered before legitimate fast close/reload; genuine and superseded attempts retain their tested handling. Combined browser and recorded native Windows retests pass.
All four shared transition-sound actions and internal audio bytes survive native ODP/OTP conversion, engine save/reopen and actual browser playback.
Uniform enabled/disabled click policy is preserved through the standard ODF setting and returned transition branches. Mixed per-slide policies remain explicitly outside this issue.
The native ODP/OTP/FODP matrix preserves right/left/up/down directions and unrelated animation, notes and page-style semantics.
The native conversion matrix and real engine round trip preserve 1800/1234/2500/3750ms, with ODF 1.3 validation and unrelated timing/parts retained.

Both application save routes refresh existing slide-number field text using current slide order and firstSlideNum. Tests cover move/delete/duplicate, hidden/unnumbered slides, source preservation and real browser save/reopen. Live cached canvas refresh remains outside this scoped issue.

Reload navigation is one-shot and canceled by newer input or document replacement. Four navigation regressions, six production custom-story stages and the recorded native Windows saved-file inspection verify the newer selection is preserved.

Both note kinds now continue with ordinary body formatting while preserving marker styling, intentional prior formatting and Undo/Redo. Twelve native-kernel regressions, four browser cases and the recorded installed Windows save/reopen/PDF retest pass.

Scoped raw paragraph navigation preserves exact cursor/text/format/selection behavior and safe fallback. CPU4/CPU8 probes verify 30 scoped reads instead of 30 full-story reads, save/reopen and spelling/viewport controls; no general smoothness guarantee is claimed.

Complex and simple SEQ fields are processed in document order, preserving explicit restarts and quoted/unquoted sequence identity. Six new real-kernel cases yield 1,2,1,2 or 7,8,7,8; existing merge preservation and production UI/export checks pass.
Whole-word counting, navigation and replacement preserve Unicode ranges, save/reopen and Undo/Redo; the bounded native two-slide test and five independent PPTX snapshots also pass.
The audio/video full-end and trimmed-end replay cases pass in the real player, together with pause/resume, seeking, updated boundaries and repeat controls.

Implicit default cells now receive the applicable table font/fill projection while inherited/direct overrides retain precedence. Explicit and implicit Medium2 native edit/save/close/reopen cases pass with independent package checks.

The actual three-page Windows PDF preserves the complete filename, author and title without overlap; independent geometry gives the same 8.41017pt separation on all pages. DOCX parts and fields are preserved as documented.

Built-in font/fill presets now follow theme and table options, with direct/custom precedence preserved. Native Medium2 edit/save/close/reopen and independent styles/table XML checks pass. Borders remain outside this issue.
New replies preserve initials captured at creation. Targeted identity/ID reuse tests, actual browser profile/cancellation/save/reopen cases and bounded native RX save/reopen/resave checks pass.

Review uses a prepared temporary replica and one local update. Worker/save synchronization, individual and bulk review, Undo/Redo and reopened native XML snapshots preserve the leading revisions and formatting.

PDF font-resolution work is invalidated by the existing availability event, including old in-flight results. Targeted tests and controlled browser checks use real font bytes; an actual native permission dialog is not claimed.

Unambiguous ODF media frame names are restored when conversion drops them; genuinely unnamed media gets distinct localized display labels. Native ODP/OTP conversion, real selector/playback and saved-package checks pass.

The integrated 15-patch kernel contains the validated linear-trendline correction. Native kernel, independent geometry and actual browser edit/Undo/save/reopen checks cover supported 2-D line/scatter fits, screen/profile/print and source preservation. Other trend types remain under #66.
Formula thresholds use the original sheet/local-name context and follow edits/Undo without changing caches, history or saved rules; invalid formulas remain unsupported rather than becoming zero.
All four/five icon levels and reversed order are preserved across screen/profile/print and saved-source checks.
Both XML boolean spellings are handled consistently, including exclusive equality, reverse order and immutable source rules.
Classic bars interpolate over their CFVO range and explicit/default length bounds, with clamping and finite geometry.
All 17 standard icon families use font-independent vector shapes and preserve distinct levels, source names and value visibility. Unsupported families are not fabricated.
Merged-cell bars use the full source rectangle; independent baseline/fixed measurements and screen/profile/print checks preserve workbook state and XML.

Bounded unambiguous bindings preserve media volume/mute through actual ODP/OTP conversion and real playback/save/reopen; stale or ambiguous metadata is rejected. Trim/start/loop work remains separate.
Only the bounded known empty DOCX bibliography seed is exempted. Real sources and unknown/extra/malformed custom XML still warn, while all source bytes remain intact.

The bounded same-frame range cache passes independent geometry, edit/Undo/Redo, zoom/resize/hide/show and saved/reopened controls. CPU4/CPU8 evidence shows fewer queries, not a general speed or total-memory guarantee.

Supported direct character-format differences become explicit styled replacements. Native comparison/review and nine saved XML snapshots verify Accept/Reject, Save/Undo/Redo and reopen; unsupported structures retain diagnostics.

Replace/Replace All restores document focus for immediate one-step Ctrl+Z while preserving text-input Undo. Actual production-browser baseline/fix, saved DOCX and reopen checks pass; this is distinct from still-open tab-focus #340.

The comment-input clipboard route is isolated from document input. The incorporated PR219 regression and combined Writer production-browser checks preserve body selection/text while pasting into the active reply. The original installed Windows report is distinct from the recorded browser retest.

The next paragraph adopts resolved destination-style defaults instead of heading font/color. Actual engine tests and six production-browser scenarios cover real keypresses, Heading1/2, deliberate formatting, Undo/Redo and independent saved XML/reopen.

Header editing now carries the hit relationship ID and scrolls/verifies the chosen page margin. Production-browser tests cover actual typing in even/first/default headers, even footers, missing-header creation, Undo/Redo and saved-part reopening without changing other stories. No additional installed-native interaction is claimed here.

All seven validation types, range/fixed/named dropdowns, input messages, stop/warning/information alerts and invalid-data circles are implemented. Actual-core, real UI/save/reopen and independent conversion controls pass. Documented formula, scan and dropdown bounds fail explicitly; they do not silently accept incomplete checks.

Classic notes and threaded replies/resolution retain author/time, cell indicators/navigation and source metadata; print modes none/at-end/as-displayed share preview/PDF rendering. Actual-core, six production-browser flows, independently inspected PDFs and XLSX interoperability checks pass.

Sheet/workbook protection management, optional password verification, locked/unlocked/hidden flags, configured action/selection permissions and source preservation are implemented. Actual-core, UI/save/reopen and independent verifier checks pass. This is accidental-edit protection, not encryption. The documented external-converter loss remains a format limitation under #32/#35.

Named cell styles and structured tables now support creation/modification, totals/banding, native row/column growth, structured references, filter controls and save/reopen preservation. Combined core/UI tests and independent table/style import controls pass, including subsequent built-in and implicit-style fixes. Documented transactional/bounded editing limitations remain visible.
All four chart criteria are implemented on main. Seven real production-browser copy/edit/save/reopen scenarios passed again on 11 November; the broader Spreadsheet chart issue remains separate.

All 86 catalog extensions have a test or an explicit missing-example explanation. The 32-fixture legacy workflow and catalog consistency check passed again. This completes catalog/evidence/error messages, not universal format fidelity.
